rule.statement: The donees' possession and enjoyment of the land for over 30 years, along with the mother's signature on the Deed of Gift, are sufficient indications of their acceptance of the gift.
rule.supporting_quote: Considering the totality of the circumstances in this appeal, it is abundantly clear that at the time of the execution of the Deed of Gift, it was clearly stated in the said Deed that the gift was accepted by the mother of the donees on behalf of the donees and she had also signed the said Deed of Gift. Moreover, the donees had possessed and had enjoyed the land in question for more than 30 years.
